purpose: Audio orchestration defaults shared by pycore (pyctl/audio_orchestration), the pycore-manager UI and the wordnew client composer (shared/orchestration). docs_fix/REQUIREMENTS_20260930_WORDNEW_CLIENT_ORCHESTRATION.md section 4.3.

transfer.purpose: Clip transfer between pycore / Laravel and the clients: pycore serves one cached clip raw (resource/file, GET) and many in one framed response (resource/bundle, POST); Laravel answers URL batches (sentence/audio/head, word/audio/head) and serves the files statically.
transfer.pycore_bundle_frame: per request item, in order: 4-byte big-endian header length, UTF-8 JSON header {index, key, hit, bytes, sent, meaning}, then `bytes` payload bytes when sent is true (a hit past the byte budget is sent:false and is asked again)

step_options.meaning: word steps only: after each word, read its short Chinese meaning (wordnew implements it; pycore: docs_fix/TODO_20260930_PYCORE_ORCH_WORD_MEANING.md)
